name: Cypress
summary: A JavaScript end-to-end and component testing tool that runs inside the browser, known for its interactive runner and time-travel debugging.
strengths: Interactive runner with time-travel snapshots makes debugging fast.
Built-in retry-ability for queries and assertions.
Component testing for React, Vue, Angular and Svelte in the same tool.
Network stubbing with cy.intercept is simple and well documented.
tradeoffs: Runs inside the browser, so multi-tab flows and some cross-origin flows need workarounds.
Parallel runs and analytics are tied to the paid Cypress Cloud or third-party services.
